name: HyperXosist Missions
description: Multi-angle search campaigns for any AI agent. Includes optional Grok Build harvest missions. Noise excludes are priority-capped.
whySticky: Deterministic multi-angle missions beat one-off keyword guesses.
scoreQuery prevents wasting x402 on weak queries.
suggestRefinements self-heals empty/noisy runs without human help.
buildHandoffPackage chains into Signal-to-Fix PR specs in one hop.
buildGrokBuildPrompt turns Keep signals into one-small-change Grok Build tasks.
Receipts + encodeState make weekly monitors and audits trivial.
Tool definitions drop into OpenAI/Anthropic tool-calling with zero inventing.

missions.label: Product feedback radar
missions.whyAgentsUseIt: Multi-angle complaints + feature requests + bugs in one deterministic campaign. Highest reuse rate for shipping loops.

missions.label: Competitive intelligence
missions.whyAgentsUseIt: Compare subject vs alternatives with noise cut — good for weekly monitoring jobs.

missions.label: Launch / news pulse
missions.whyAgentsUseIt: Time-boxed discourse snapshot for launches and incidents.

missions.label: Signal-to-Fix pipeline
missions.whyAgentsUseIt: End-to-end: clean X candidates → handoff package → keep-only PR specs. The sticky agent habit loop.

missions.label: Entity / person OSINT
missions.whyAgentsUseIt: Structured from/to/mention angles without engagement-bait noise.

missions.label: Weekly monitor (7d)
missions.whyAgentsUseIt: Cron-friendly 7-day window with stable operators — ideal recurring agent jobs.

missions.label: Grok Build code improvement radar
missions.whyAgentsUseIt: Harvest concrete bugs/feature asks → technical-depth Keep filter → Grok Build Prompt for one small code change.

missions.label: UI/UX feedback harvest
missions.whyAgentsUseIt: Frontend-oriented angles for Grok Build UI patches and layout fixes.

missions.label: Performance complaint detector
missions.whyAgentsUseIt: Latency/jank/memory complaints for Grok Build perf-focused micro-improvements.
